probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A __computer-implemented__ method comprising: storing, in a non-transitory computer readable medium, a receiver operating characteristic analysis of historical data for a region of interest on each of a plurality of different subjects, __wherein the historical data and experimentally-determined data each comprise spatially-resolved ophthalmic measurement data for corresponding spatial locations in the region of interest__; performing, with a processor, a comparison of experimentally-determined data of a medical patient to the receiver operating characteristic analysis of the historical data __at corresponding spatial locations in the region of interest__; identifying, with the processor, __a subset of spatial locations in the region of interest at which the experimentally-determined data is an accurate predictor of a medical condition based on the receiver operating characteristic analysis of the historical data, and identifying the experimentally-determined data at the identified subset of spatial locations__ to be utilized to reach an at least preliminary conclusion regarding the medical patient based on the experimentally-determined data; and presenting on a display device a visible display graphically depicting a result of the comparison __for the identified subset of spatial locations in the region of interest__.

(Currently amended) A __computer-implemented__ method comprising: accessing, from a non-transitory computer readable medium, a receiver operating characteristic analysis of historical data for the region of interest on each of a plurality of different subjects, __wherein the historical data and experimentally-determined data each comprise spatially-resolved ophthalmic measurement data for corresponding spatial locations in the region of interest__; identifying, with a processor, a subset of spatial locations in the region of interest where the experimentally-determined data is an accurate predictor of the medical condition to be utilized to reach an at least preliminary conclusion regarding the medical patient based on the receiver operating characteristic analysis of the historical data; comparing, with the processor, the experimentally-determined data at the subset of spatial locations of the medical patient to the receiver operating characteristic analysis of the historical data; and graphically expressing, on a display device, a result of said comparing __for the subset of spatial locations in the region of interest__.
